---
# Software catalog for tools/software.qmd.
#
# Each package is one entry. To add a package, copy an entry into the right
# list (software-r / software-python / software-js / friends) and fill in:
#   name        display name (usually the package name)
#   description one concise sentence
#   repo        GitHub slug "org/name" (used to build the "code" link)
#   docs        documentation / pkgdown / website URL (optional)
#   category    one short tag shown as a badge (Access, Validate, Evaluate,
#               Ensemble, Visualize, Admin, Utility, Examples, CI, Dev,
#               Transform, Dashboard, Meta)
#
# The lists below drive the catalog automatically via _partials/package-card.qmd.

# --- Core hubverse R packages (see https://hubverse-org.r-universe.dev/packages) ---
software-r:
  - name: hubverse
    description: "Meta-package that installs and loads the full suite of hubverse R packages in one step."
    repo: hubverse-org/hubverse
    docs: https://hubverse-org.r-universe.dev/hubverse
    category: Meta
  - name: hubData
    description: "Connect to, access, and manipulate hub model-output and target data."
    repo: hubverse-org/hubData
    docs: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubData
    category: Access
  - name: hubAdmin
    description: "Create and validate hub configuration files such as admin.json and tasks.json."
    repo: hubverse-org/hubAdmin
    docs: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubAdmin
    category: Admin
  - name: hubValidations
    description: "Validate model-output submissions, typically as pull-request CI checks on a hub."
    repo: hubverse-org/hubValidations
    docs: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubValidations
    category: Validate
  - name: hubEnsembles
    description: "Build ensembles from model outputs, including weighted and quantile averages and linear pools."
    repo: hubverse-org/hubEnsembles
    docs: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubEnsembles
    category: Ensemble
  - name: hubEvals
    description: "Evaluate and score infectious-disease model outputs."
    repo: hubverse-org/hubEvals
    docs: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubEvals
    category: Evaluate
  - name: hubVis
    description: "Plot and visualize hub model outputs to synthesize model submissions."
    repo: hubverse-org/hubVis
    docs: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubVis
    category: Visualize
  - name: hubExamples
    description: "Example forecasting and scenario-modeling data in the hubverse format."
    repo: hubverse-org/hubExamples
    docs: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubExamples
    category: Examples
  - name: hubUtils
    description: "Lightweight utility functions shared across hubverse packages."
    repo: hubverse-org/hubUtils
    docs: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubUtils
    category: Utility
  - name: hubCI
    description: "Set up and manage hubverse continuous-integration workflows."
    repo: hubverse-org/hubCI
    docs: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubCI
    category: CI
  - name: hubDevs
    description: "Utilities for creating and standardizing new hubverse packages."
    repo: hubverse-org/hubDevs
    docs: https://hubverse-org.github.io/hubDevs
    category: Dev

# --- Python packages ---
software-python:
  - name: hubdata
    description: "Python tools for accessing and working with hubverse hub data."
    repo: hubverse-org/hub-data
    docs: https://pypi.org/project/hubdata/
    category: Access
  - name: hubverse-transform
    description: "Transform hubverse model-output files; used in the cloud data pipeline."
    repo: hubverse-org/hubverse-transform
    category: Transform

# --- JavaScript components ---
software-js:
  - name: predtimechart
    description: "A predtimechart-based forecast-visualization component for hub dashboards."
    repo: hubverse-org/hub-dashboard-predtimechart
    category: Dashboard
  - name: predevals
    description: "A JavaScript module for interactive exploration of forecast evaluations."
    repo: hubverse-org/predevals
    category: Dashboard

# --- Friends of the hubverse: tools from the wider community ---
friends:
  - name: scoringutils
    description: "Evaluate and score probabilistic forecasts with a range of proper scoring rules."
    repo: epiforecasts/scoringutils
    docs: https://epiforecasts.io/scoringutils/
    category: Evaluate
  - name: alloscore
    description: "Scoring methods for allocation and decision problems built on forecasts."
    repo: aaronger/alloscore
    docs: https://academic.oup.com/jrsssa/article/188/4/1299/7927906
    category: Evaluate
  - name: modelimportance
    description: "Measures the contribution and importance of individual models within an ensemble."
    repo: mkim425/modelimportance
    docs: https://mkim425.r-universe.dev/modelimportance
    category: Evaluate
  - name: fable
    description: "Forecasting models that can be evaluated, visualized & combined in tidyverse style."
    repo: tidyverts/fable
    docs: https://fable.tidyverts.org/
    category: Forecast
  - name: EpiBenchmark
    description: "Benchmark and compare epidemic forecasting models."
    repo: accidda/EpiBenchmark
    docs: https://accidda.github.io/EpiBenchmark/
    category: Evaluate
---
